description: CORRECTED IN ROUND 12 - the original verdict was backwards. query_system_catalog is a ROLE. server/current/learn/security/roles.md documents it with its own table, headed 'Role: Query System Catalog (query_system_catalog)', and prose reading 'The Query System Catalog role lets the user query the system catalog using SQL++'. metafun.md, which this issue originally filed as the drift for calling it a role, agrees with the authoritative catalogue. The real inconsistency is the other way round: the AWR and monitoring reference pages call it a privilege, and Server has no privilege catalogue for it to be in. Original description, retained: metafun.md calls query_system_catalog a *role* ('you must have the `query_system_catalog` role'), whereas the same string is documented as a privilege elsewhere and was extracted into the privilege: namespace from the AWR and monitoring pages.
correction: Round 10 read this as 'privileges filed as roles' and folded rbac-role:query-system-catalog and rbac-role:query-manage-system-catalog into privilege:, citing a round-6 precedent that does not exist in reconciliation.md. Round 12 read roles.md - the first round to do so - and reversed it: eleven ids re-filed from privilege: to role:. The docs inconsistency this issue records is still open; only the POC's reading of which page was wrong has changed.
